g.text: Retina and vision GO enrichment in the 1-month Ddx41 conditional knockout

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: CHX10-Cre; Ddx41 fl/fl vs. littermate control, n = 3 per genotype. Restricted to the eye/vision part of the GO DAG (22 curated roots and their descendants),

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: so membership follows the ontology, not the wording of a term name. Over-representation among DESeq2 padj < 0.05 genes, against the 17,444 tested GO-annotated genes.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Filled bubbles pass FDR < 0.05 in both a hypergeometric and an expression-matched permutation test. No retina term clears that bar among down-regulated genes, so that

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: panel instead shows its strongest nominal candidates (raw p < 0.10, fold enrichment > 1) as hollow bubbles; those are not enrichment claims.
